effect.en: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.

flavor.en: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
flavor.ko: 수컷은 암컷을 암컷은 수컷을 유혹하여 헤롱헤롱하게 만든다. 상대가 기술을 쓰기 어려워진다.
